'''Kiril Drapaneos den Alangar''' is a nobleman from [[Illian]] and one of the [[Council of Nine]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kiril Drapaneos den Alangar}}

== Appearance ==
He is a stork of a man with a square cut beard and a narrow face.

== Activities ==
He fights in [[Rand al'Thor]]'s army against the [[Seanchan]] trying to invade [[Illian]]. He follows [[Weiramon Saniago]] into the final assault on the Seanchan.
